title: DANTINOX：多范式语言建模统一框架
summary: DantinoX 是一个开源 JAX/Flax 库，用单一模块化 Transformer 主干支持自回归解码、离散掩码扩散和连续流匹配三种生成范式。仅需修改配置即可切换生成范式、注意力机制或硬件拓扑，保持主干架构、分词器、初始化与训练设施一致，从而实现受控的跨范式对比。
summary_en: DantinoX is an open-source JAX/Flax library where a single modular Transformer backbone serves three generation paradigms: autoregressive decoding, discrete masked diffusion, and continuous flow-matching. Switching paradigm, attention mechanism, or hardware topology requires only a config change, enabling controlled cross-paradigm comparisons within one API for training, streaming inference, and benchmarking.
